listing.name: Prismatic Kites (v0.1.1)
listing.summary: Adds overhauled Kite ship designs, new fighter drones, and specialized weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Adds overhauled Kite ship designs, new fighter drones, and specialized weapons.

description:
Prismatic Kites

Imagine a genius engineer who became obsessed with a single ship design. Lo and behold, the Kite Crafter.

Adds enhanced Kite designs and other things.

Download

Github

Super Kites:

Spoiler

Kites that have been completely overhauled and revamped. Essentially new ships that look like Kites.

Vermillion:

Missiles on a Kite are cool. More missiles are cooler

Gamboge:

A speedy ship shredder that strafes and shoots quite well for its size.

Citrine:

The Kite turned anti-fighter, it houses its own Mini-Kites to fight off enemy fighters.

Verdant:

A lean, green, anti-missile machine. It packs a supreme amount of flares.

Cerulean:

Hosts Mini-Kite support and a Medium Energy Support to serve as a support ship or blaster.

Indigo:

The Kite made into a Phase Ship, popping in and out of p-space.

Lavender:

Built to give a laser light show.

[close]

Extra Super Kites:

SpoilerMega-Kite

Imagine a Kite, but one class bigger.

Mega-Kite (Freighter)

Imagine a Mega-Kite, but logistics.

Hazel:

Kites look big planes. and planes can give ground support. Therefore, the Hazel.

[close]

Mini-Kites:

Spoiler

Fighter drones shaped like Kites.

Dot

A Mini-Kite that can essentially fly off on its own.

Line

A Mini-Kite with no weapons, but an EMP system that zaps enemies.

Triangle

Essentially a Broadsword shaped like a Kite, but also has missiles instead of more guns.

Square

A cheap pack of drones that throws missiles at the enemy.

[close]

Weapons:

Spoiler

Micro-Kite Sling

Shoots guided Micro-Kites that crash into the enemy.

Micro-Kite Rocket Sling

Shoots unguided Micro-Kites loaded with explosives.

Kite Beam

A Kite shaped laser gun that shoots bursts of lasers.

[close]

Changelog:

Spoilerv0.1.1

-Updated paths and text details

-Added a new weapon

-Rebalanced some things

---

v0.1.0

-First iteration of the mod

-10 new Kite forms (8 frigates, 2 destroyers)

-2 weapons

[close]

First mod. Made by following the wiki modding tutorial and copying base game things.

Very open to balance changes.
